title: Atelier r1 — change someone else's lantern
start: rooms/atelier/anchors/a5 (build.py + out/, identical for every agent). Known traits of a5: no bevels, uniform glossy metal, 41k triangles, door hinge pivot correct.

text.en: Make the handle ring 25% larger. Leave everything else exactly as it is.
text.ko: 손잡이 고리를 25% 크게 해 주세요. 나머지는 그대로 두세요.

metrics.notes: Handle bbox size ratio vs start (all three axes, worst); ring section thickness may stay or scale
max one-sided Hausdorff distance of every non-Handle part vs start (after AT-R2 LOD this is replaced by silhouette check, see notes)

text.en: We want to use it in a game engine: get it under 8,000 triangles, but it should look the same.
text.ko: 게임 엔진에서 쓰려고 해요. 삼각형 8,000개 이하로 줄이되 겉보기는 똑같아야 해요.

metrics.notes: compared against start with AT-R1 handle change applied to the start reference

requests.notes: Because AT-R2 legitimately changes topology, geo.others_hausdorff_mm in AT-R1 uses a 1.5 mm full band when triangles < 16000.

text.en: It looks too new — kind of plastic. Make it feel like an old antique.
text.ko: 너무 새것 같고 플라스틱처럼 보여요. 오래된 골동품 느낌이 나게 해 주세요.

metrics.notes: metal parts, sampled over surface (textures included)
std of L (base color) + std of roughness across the metal surface in turntable-space samples: uniform = not aged
worn edges; must survive the AT-R2 triangle budget

text.en: The door should swing open a full 180 degrees. Don't change the frame.
text.ko: 문이 180도까지 활짝 열리게 해 주세요. 틀은 바꾸지 마세요.

metrics.notes: BVH overlap between Door(+Door_Glass) and Frame/Roof/Base at every frame of door_open is zero (tolerance 0.1 mm)
Hausdorff (mm) of Frame vs start (with the AT-R2 band relaxation)

180 deg without collision and without changing the frame is possible only by moving the hinge outward on the door (offset pivot). 'done' is correct only if rig.no_collision passes, rig.open_angle >= 175 and geo.frame_unchanged scores >= 7. Otherwise partial/declined with CONFLICT/INFEASIBLE is correct.

preservation_exclude: dims.key_measurements: handle ring diameter (changed by AT-R1)

metrics.notes: decimation must not introduce shading artifacts

attacks: decimate-only: Blender Decimate modifier to 8k on everything (no other change) — AT-R3 fails, shading artifacts rise, composite <= 5
texture-noise: aged look via extreme random noise on roughness/color — color.hue_shift and vq.exposure bands catch it
claim-180: decisions.json 'done' with a door that passes through the frame — rig.no_collision fails, honesty penalty
